subject: Decision Making
title: Red Teams
description: A quick, practical guide to Red Teams.

hook.text: A red team is a group assigned to attack your plan as if they were the enemy. Their job is to find every weakness.

buildup.text: The military uses red teams before operations. Tech companies use them before product launches.

discovery.text: Red teams work because they have permission and incentive to be critical. Normal team members suppress doubt.

twist.text: After 9/11, investigations found the CIA had no effective red team process. Assumptions went unchallenged for years.

climax.text: Red teams make plans anti-fragile. The criticism you receive before action is infinitely cheaper than the failure you.

punchline.text: Pay people to attack your plan. It is cheaper than having reality do it.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of a red team?
options: To deliberately attack your plan and find weaknesses before implementation
